crossRefs.note: Most certainly, the evil man will not be unpunished, but the offspring of the righteous will be delivered.
The house of the wicked will be overthrown, but the tent of the upright will flourish.
Yahweh will uproot the house of the proud, but he will keep the widow’s borders intact.
In the citadel of Susa, the Jews killed and destroyed five hundred men.
The king commanded this to be done. A decree was given out in Susa; and they hanged Haman’s ten sons.
I have seen the foolish taking root, but suddenly I cursed his habitation.
His children are far from safety. They are crushed in the gate. Neither is there any to deliver them,
But the eyes of the wicked will fail. They will have no way to flee. Their hope will be the giving up of the spirit.”
There will dwell in his tent that which is none of his. Sulfur will be scattered on his habitation.
He builds his house as the moth, as a booth which the watchman makes.
For yet a little while, and the wicked will be no more. Yes, though you look for his place, he isn’t there.
I have seen the wicked in great power, spreading himself like a green tree in its native soil.
Surely you set them in slippery places. You throw them down to destruction.
How they are suddenly destroyed! They are completely swept away with terrors.
Every wise woman builds her house, but the foolish one tears it down with her own hands.
Through wisdom a house is built; by understanding it is established;
by knowledge the rooms are filled with all rare and beautiful treasure.
Your house and your kingdom will be made sure forever before you. Your throne will be established forever.” ’ ”
Let your name be magnified forever, saying, ‘Yahweh of Armies is God over Israel; and the house of your servant David…
“Everyone therefore who hears these words of mine, and does them, I will liken him to a wise man, who built his house…

translations.web: The wicked are overthrown, and are no more, but the house of the righteous shall stand.
translations.bsb: The wicked are overthrown and perish, but the house of the righteous will stand.
translations.kjv: The wicked are overthrown, and are not: but the house of the righteous shall stand.
translations.asv: The wicked are overthrown, and are not; But the house of the righteous shall stand.
